title: Task params for oedis.handler.sharepoint.download
description: Configuration for downloading files from a SharePoint document library into the task inbox.

connection.description: SharePoint and Microsoft Graph connection settings used to resolve the site, drive, and access token.

drive.description: Drive or document library name inside the SharePoint site.

auth.description: Microsoft Graph app-only credentials used to request an access token.

tenant_id.description: Microsoft Entra tenant ID used to request the Graph access token.

client_id.description: Application client ID used for SharePoint access.

client_secret.description: Application client secret used for SharePoint access.

timeout_sec.description: Optional request timeout in seconds for Microsoft Graph API calls.

requests.description: List of SharePoint download instructions. Each item describes one remote source selection under the configured drive and how matched files should be copied into the inbox.

src_dir.description: Remote source directory relative to the selected SharePoint drive. Leave empty or omit it to discover files directly from the drive root. Absolute paths are rejected.

dst_dir.description: Destination directory under ctx.inbox. Leave empty or omit it to copy directly into ctx.inbox. Must be a relative local path when provided.

recursive.description: When true, walk subdirectories under src_dir. When false, only files directly under src_dir are considered.

include.description: File match pattern or list of patterns to include. Matching is attempted against the path relative to src_dir. File-name-only patterns such as '*.csv' still work because they are evaluated against that relative path. Prefer recursive=true with patterns like '*.csv' instead of '**/*.csv'.

exclude.description: File match pattern or list of patterns to exclude after include matching. Matching is attempted against the path relative to src_dir.

updated_after.description: Optional lower bound for lastModifiedDateTime. Accepts the datetime string formats supported by the handler.

updated_before.description: Optional exclusive upper bound for lastModifiedDateTime. Accepts the datetime string formats supported by the handler.
